## Changes

- **One period choice for stacked charts.** The charts of several hops on a target's tab, and of several targets on All targets, always share their period; the choice and the shown time range are now only on the top chart.

## Fixes

- **Ping Watch no longer loads Vulkan drivers**, and draws with Direct3D 12 only. The Vulkan driver of older Intel graphics (31.0.101.2xxx) closed Ping Watch at start with an error in `igvk64.dll`.
- **Ping Watch draws on the graphics card chosen for it in Windows** (Settings → Display → Graphics), by default the power-saving one of a laptop, instead of always the discrete one.

## Known issue

- On a laptop with two graphics cards the discrete one still stays switched on while Ping Watch runs, though it doesn't draw on it. This comes from the egui library ([emilk/egui#8704](https://github.com/emilk/egui/issues/8704)) and goes away with its fix.
